record.context_brief: Weight-aspect sixth moment for Rankin-Selberg L-values
record.original_question: Use the work of Humphries and Khan to compute weight-aspect upper bounds for the sixth moment of L(1/2, f tensor g) when f and g vary over primitive forms of level 1 and weights k and ell, under the conditions |k - ell| = O(1) and K < k + ell <= 2K.

evidence.quote: Use the recent work of Humphries-Khan [42] to compute weight aspect upper bounds for the 6th moment of L(1/2, f ⊗ g) where f and g vary over the set of primitive forms of level 1 and weights k and ℓ respectively, with |k − ℓ| = O(1) and K < k + ℓ <= 2K.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $H_k$ denote the set of primitive (Hecke-normalized) holomorphic cusp forms of level 1 and even weight $k$ for $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$. For $f \in H_k$ and $g \in H_\ell$, let $L(s, f \otimes g)$ denote the Rankin–Selberg $L$-function attached to the pair $(f,g)$, analytically normalized so that the central point is $s = 1/2$.

Let $K \to \infty$. Establish a non-trivial upper bound, as sharp as possible, for the weight-aspect sixth moment
$$
\sum_{\substack{k+\ell \\ K < k+\ell \le 2K \\ |k-\ell| = O(1)}} \;\sum_{f \in H_k} \sum_{g \in H_\ell} \bigl| L(\tfrac{1}{2}, f \otimes g) \bigr|^{6},
$$
where the outer sum is over pairs of even weights $(k,\ell)$ satisfying $|k-\ell| = O(1)$ and $K < k+\ell \le 2K$. In particular, derive consequences for subconvex bounds on $L(1/2, f \otimes g)$ in this family.
artifact.status_search_result: Web search reveals related work by Humphries–Khan on the twelfth moment of Hecke L-functions in the weight aspect (Math. Ann. 2024), and earlier work by Khan on the fifth moment, but no published result establishing the weight-aspect sixth moment bound specifically for L(1/2, f⊗g) with f,g primitive forms of nearby weights k,ℓ. The problem appears to be an explicitly posed open question.

status_evidence.title: The Twelfth Moment of Hecke L-Functions in the Weight Aspect
status_evidence.snippet: Humphries–Khan prove an upper bound for the twelfth moment of Hecke L-functions for holomorphic cusp forms of weight k in a dyadic interval, recovering Weyl-strength subconvexity.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the spectral reciprocity tools suggested for use, but does not establish the sixth moment of Rankin–Selberg L-values.

status_evidence.title: The fifth moment of Hecke L-functions in the weight aspect
status_evidence.snippet: Khan proves an upper bound for the fifth moment of Hecke L-functions in the weight-aspect dyadic interval K<k<2K.
status_evidence.claim: Closest prior moment result, treats degree-2 L-functions rather than Rankin–Selberg degree-4 L-functions.
